title: 10in1 Mushroom Coffee Powder, Premium Arabica Instant Coffee Blend With Mane, Reishi, Chaga  8 Functional Mushrooms, Low Caffeine, Non GMO, FillerFree,1 LB
body_html:
10-in-1 Mushroom Coffee Powder, Premium Arabica Instant Coffee Blend with Lion’s Mane, Reishi, Chaga & 8 Functional Mushrooms, Low Caffeine, Non-GMO, Filler-Free, 1 LB (454g)
(1)10 Superfood Mushroom Complex Blend
Crafted with 10 potent functional mushrooms: Lion’s Mane, Reishi, Chaga, Cordyceps, Turkey Tail, Shiitake, Maitake, Mesima, Wood Ear & Oyster Mushroom, packed with adaptogens, antioxidants and polyphenols for steady energy & focus.
(2)Smooth Medium Roast Arabica Base, Low Caffeine
Made from premium arabica instant coffee with mild low caffeine content. Tastes like classic fresh coffee without harsh bitter notes; avoids jitters and post-coffee energy crashes common with regular coffee.
(3)Clean, All-Natural Clean Formula
100% natural, Non-GMO, filler-free, free of soy, dairy, gluten, preservatives, artificial flavors and tree nuts. Every batch passes third-party lab testing for purity, safety and full potency.
(4)Steady Clean Energy & Brain Support
Perfect coffee alternative for daily use. Nootropic mushroom blend delivers sustainable calm energy, boosts mental clarity and focus without uncomfortable nervousness or energy drops.
(5)Bulk 1LB Family Size Instant Powder
454g large bulk pack, easy instant dissolvable powder. Brew a single mug for personal use or a full pot to share with family; ideal for morning routines, workdays and travel.
